note.value:
Initial Setup: The Grey Seer starts the game with 24 Warp Tokens and all Skaven Spells in hand.

Casting Spells: To cast a spell a Grey Seer must roll the casting cost of the spell. They may consume any number of Warp Tokens to add +1 to the attempt per token. A roll of 1 always fails. Discard the spell no matter the outcome. You may discard spells you have no means of casting. Renew hand once all spells are cast.

Failing to Cast: If the spell fails to cast (not due to a dispel) roll a d6 per token consumed and check for doubles. Double 1: Grey Seer explodes, All remaining spells in hand cast centered on the Grey Seer's ship; Double 2-4: Roll a d6, Grey Seer consumes that much additional Warp Tokens; Double 5-6: The Grey Seer gains +1 to cast next turn.

Dispelling Skaven Magic (7+): Wizards attempting to dispel Skaven Magic must discard 2 cards to get a +1 to dispel. No automatic dispels.

Grey Seer Dispelling (7+): Grey Seers dispel using Warp Tokens. Each token adds +1 to the dispel attempt. Always roll as if Failing to Cast a spell.
